question: Evaluate the differences in digital readiness of South Asia compared to Europe region
query: SELECT      "year",     "region" as "asia_reg",     "country_name" as "south_asia_country",     "digital_connectivity_index",     "governance_quality_index" FROM      global_development_indicators WHERE      ("region" IN ('Asia', 'Europe'))     AND ("is_pandemic_period" = FALSE)     AND ("year" >= 2000) LIMIT 50;
